_comment: NO rarity_filter and NO in_square, both deliberately. A rarity in front of a cell gate throws away the one chunk that matters - ArchFeature learned that - and the docket is its own gate: it answers empty for all but one chunk in perChunks per listing. An in_square would offset the origin, and the berth's own absolute coordinates are the answer, so a shifted origin would make the containment test lie. count 1 so the carrier is asked exactly once per chunk.
